name: 02721 · Fall River, MA
findings: ZIP 02721 (Fall River) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02721 (Fall River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02721 (Fall River) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
